name: Ink test
author: Edgemodders
description: The spike of the ink API (I1): finds roots in the game's own UI (REDnode's script hooks, and Codeware's layers), adds a text, a rectangle and a clickable button through the api, times changes, opens a game screen, lists the game's menu entries and writes an open screen's widget tree to a file. Asks for the bridge permission (to find the menu resources).
